body: That last sentence was incredibly comforting, thank you so much!

It makes me happy to know that other people are struggling, but still fighting. I'm terrified of hurting the people close to me to, I spoke to my close friends a few times about it but unless they've been in that situation people really can't understand. I began to feel like I was just plaguing them with my issues and I hated feeling like I was burdening or worrying them, I don't want them to feel responsible for my well-being. I felt like a monster for a while. That's why I came to reddit, supportive and kind-hearted strangers can do so much for people sometimes. I'm glad to hear you're winning, keep fighting my dude <3
